items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And this package was Coleman Hawkins... Howard McGhee had a band... Shadow Wilson was in the band and Billy Taylor was in the band... Nelson Boyd... Hawk also liked to play in difficult keys... There was a rhythm section and saxophone. They had Phil Woods, Coleman Hawkins, Rouse... and Bennie Carter

ctx.x: Oh, we went to Paris, and we played the Ambassador Club, we played a theatre, the [Marini] Theatre. It was on the Champs Elysees. And this package was Coleman Hawkins, and this was the first time he'd been back to Europe, since before the war. And Howard McGhee had a band, that went -- let's see, we had a blues singer by the name of Chippie Chippy Hill, who was a friend of my mother's, incidentally.
And she would curse these Frenchmen out and they didn't know what she was saying. She was pure earth, you know.
